Receipt fields in success records reference prior ARTIFACT/OBSERVATION/CONSUMPTION records, NEVER their own final COMPLETED_WORK publication. sources.NORMATIVE_PROPOSITION: Error record selection follows result_code; errors never enter observed/published health states. No error/denial equivalence with every canonical case label follows.
